list_automations.after: FUB documents this endpoint for Automations 2.0 accounts and registered systems only. Tool availability does not establish API/account access. GET requests do not require FUB_MCP_ALLOW_AUTOMATIONS. Preserve the sanitized tool error and HTTP status as returned; do not request or expose upstream response bodies or secrets. A returned FUB HTTP 403 is an upstream refusal, not a local mutation-gate failure; do not infer a specific account, plan, or credential cause or enable mutation gates to fix a read. The published response schema does not specify workflow definition fields; inspect actual returned data before claiming trigger, condition, or action coverage.
